title: Architecture
body:
# Architecture

VibeLang gives Effect a language syntax while keeping the TypeScript ecosystem. An inferred contract tracks success A, expected failures E and requirements R.

The native compiler checks .vibe and .ts together. The runtime supplies continuations, services and regions. The TypeScript 7 mapper is a separate checking projection; its executable rendering is unfinished.

Sources: [README.md](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/README.md?L=42), [typescript/tsc/internal/vibelangmapper/plan.go](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/typescript/tsc/internal/vibelangmapper/plan.go?L=14).

title: Compiler pipeline
body:
# Compiler pipeline

Parse VibeLang, resolve lambda and argument forms, record semantic edits, then render virtual TypeScript for checking. Verbatim source spans retain language-service mapping. Checking and executable renderings share one edit plan.

A resolver choice reports EK9100. A block owns its fork’s Scope; an expression-body fork retains Scope in R. Completion records carry returns across regions.

Sources: [typescript/tsc/internal/vibelangmapper/lambdas.go](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/typescript/tsc/internal/vibelangmapper/lambdas.go?L=47), [typescript/tsc/internal/vibelangmapper/plan.go](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/typescript/tsc/internal/vibelangmapper/plan.go?L=270).

title: Golden set
body:
# Golden set

The converter is off for Monday. Enabling it needs a real run where at least 16 of 20 model outputs compile, including the hero. The illustrative 14/20 expected-source validation is excluded from gate history; no model execution receipt is available. The gate records model, prompt, compiler and dependency digests.

The pinned prompt builder uses separate examples. The earlier illustrative snapshot had an invalid holdout; no new model execution receipt is available. score.mjs checks expected outputs, not model-generated conversions. Passing expected outputs does not pass the converter gate or measure held-out accuracy.

title: Release
body:
# Release

create-vibelang is 0.0.1. Pin vibelang, vibelang-runtime and vibelang-vite together. Effect and platform packages stay at 4.0.5.

Repack the existing tarball, verify platform payloads and permissions, scaffold a clean app, then exercise npm ci. The docs deploy checks snippets with the released compiler and runtime. A person authorizes publishing.

Sources: [packages/create-vibelang/package.json](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/packages/create-vibelang/package.json?L=3), [scripts/release/repack.mjs](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/scripts/release/repack.mjs?L=41), [scripts/deploy-docs.sh](smithers.sh/effeck/effeck/blob/main/scripts/deploy-docs.sh?L=36).
